text_block_list.text:
During training, Seiun Sky got injured, so 
I quickly brought her to the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! I might have messed up big time...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"A catastrophic blunder, coming from the 
great Sei-chan...!"
choice_data_list: I'll work out a comeback plan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, I'm fine, really. Don't worry so 
much.
choice_data_list: Could you please stay quiet and rest?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, that depends on the time and 
place, of course.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...For now at least, it seems best to 
just rest and take it easy..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When you worry about me that much, it 
makes it kind of hard to trick you, you 
know...?

"The injury must have really taken its 
toll, because for once, Seiun Sky actually 
dedicated herself to resting up."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I'll do my best to 
focus on my recovery.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Or so it seemed, but it's an escape!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I hate being forced to stay still, but 
even Sei-chan might be out of tricks this 
time...

Perhaps feeling the toll of the injury, 
Seiun Sky made an effort to get plenty of 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh... It doesn't hurt that much? If it's 
just this much, I might be okay!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mm, I'm fine. I could run lightly, and it 
doesn't feel like I need complete bed 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I slack off like I always do, I'm sure 
I'll be all better. Later then!

True to her word, Seiun Sky successfully 
made her return from injury at her own 
pace.
